story_type: vessel on the rocks, hoist with dog
hook: Three men and a dog, thirty seconds from the rocks
narration: Thirty seconds after the last man and the dog were lifted off, this boat hit the rocks.
Their fishing boat had drifted for hours toward the snowy rocks of Esther Island, Alaska.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Kodiak raced over the mountains at ten thousand feet.
They cut anchor for a tow, and suddenly it was chaos.
With no time for checklists, they lowered the swimmer down.
A rescue strop loops under the arms, and it does not fit a dog.
So the swimmer and the last man held the dog between them.
outcome: All three men and the dog were lifted to safety.
title: 30 seconds before this boat hit rocks
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak hoisted three men and a dog from a fishing boat drifting onto the rocks of Esther Island, Alaska, Dec. 12, 2022.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Lt. Scott Kellerman, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/884516/air-station-kodiak-sar-case-dec-12-2022-aerial-footage-and-hoist-camera
